title: HOLY HOLY HOLY HOLY

lines.text: As we lift our hearts before you
As a token of our love.
We're so blessed to be your children,
As we lift our heads before you
As a token of our love,
We're so glad that you redeemed us, precious Jesus.
As we lift our hands before you
As a token of our love,
Come renew us with Your love
As we lift our voice before You,
As a token of our love,
As we lift our hearts before you,
As a token of our love,
